narrative.overview: lookstar19 is set like a minor-planet circular: every page is an issue that opens with a masthead (wordmark, issue number, date) and continues as dense, aligned element blocks and fixed-width columns. The page is a working publication, not a poster of one: navigation, the lookup field and the launch block all sit inside the circular's own grammar. One saturated cobalt owns whole regions (the masthead band, the next-launch block, the shape-model stage, the primary action), and everything else is near-black ink on a cool print white. Depth comes from rules, never from shadows: a heavy 3px ink rule closes the masthead and opens each section; 1px hairlines separate rows.
keyCharacteristics: Masthead band in cobalt with a huge, condensed wordmark and the issue line set in monospace.
Element blocks: symbol, label, value, unit, right-aligned in tabular figures.
Rules instead of boxes; rectangles instead of cards; no shadow, glow or rounding anywhere.
Monospace only for data, measurements, dates and identifiers.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Cobalt appears as whole fields or as the single primary action in a region; a page never carries scattered cobalt accents on a neutral ground.

rules.name: The Paper Is Cool Rule
rules.body: The ground stays cool white; warming it toward cream drops the world into the category default.

rules.name: The Measured Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace sets only what is measured or identified: numbers, units, dates, designations, the issue line. Prose and class names are never set in mono.

rules.name: The Rule Opens The Section Rule
rules.body: Every section begins with a 3px ink rule under its heading; nothing else marks a section's start.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, glow or blur anywhere; an element that needs separation gets a rule or an ink border.

dos: Do put every measured value in an element block or a table column, right-aligned, with its unit.
Do keep cobalt as whole fields or one primary action per region.
Do close the masthead and open each section with a 3px ink rule.
Do write a source line under every dataset or model.
donts: Don't add shadows, glows, gradients or rounded cards.
Don't set prose, headings or class names in monospace.
Don't warm the paper toward cream or add a second accent color.
Don't place a small label above a heading; the heading carries itself.
Don't use agency logos, seals or insignia as decoration.
